text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B after a large gain reminds me not to treat my cost basis or a winning position as a reason to sell; decisions should reflect forward-looking prospects and portfolio needs.","I should apply the same forward-looking standards to losing positions as to winners, rather than holding a loss to avoid admitting a mistake or letting loss aversion drive trades.","My account rose and fell over these months, but random short-term moves do not predict future prices; I should avoid overreacting and trade only when my plan gives a sound reason."]}
